# Release checklist

Stage: `prepared_needs_deposit`. Local files and source-value checks are complete; no deposit or approval is implied.

| Gate | Status | Required action |
|---|---|---|
| Data/documentation | **Verified local** | 1 CSV, README, dictionary, rights statement and evidence present; recheck source if it changes. |
| Source association and UIST relationship | **Verified public** | DOI, title, authors and UIST affiliation match; confirm derived-compilation scope. |
| Values and visual checks | **Verified local** | Table pages 12–14 and 17 visually checked; Table 1a RNM discrepancy recorded. |
| Reuse basis | **Verified public** | Article displays CC BY-SA 4.0; the responsible depositor must confirm applicable package licence and attribution. |
| Compiler/depositor/authority | **Unknown** | Name responsible human compiler/depositor and authority. |
| Normal deposit terms and collection scope | **Depositor confirmation needed** | Use the current simplified policies and complete normal deposit terms; confirm the collection scope for this derived compilation. |
| Access/privacy | **Institutional decision required** | Confirm that only aggregate cells are released and choose access/embargo. |
| Identifier/collection/date | **Unknown** | Assign separate dataset identifier, collection and actual release date through authorised deposit. |
| Production validation | **Unknown** | After authorised deposit, verify landing page, anonymous access, checksums and publication link. |

No original responses, denominators beyond reported table values, or author endorsement are inferred.
